codecParserContract.directOnlyRule: wire-and-codec-are-direct-power-basis; tower coordinates are internal schedule notation only

stackAbi.representation: BCH Script stack with byte-vector and ScriptNum typed values
stackAbi.operandOrder: push-left-then-right; binary operator consumes-right-then-left; result occupies one stack slot
stackAbi.coefficientOrder: decoded coefficients remain c0-to-cd-minus-1; no implicit reorder
stackAbi.parserBoundary: exact initial OP_DEPTH; decode and canonicality check before arithmetic; final clean primary stack=true and altstack empty
stackAbi.altStackPolicy: OP_TOALTSTACK/OP_FROMALTSTACK only at declared parser/algorithm nodes; final altstack empty

normalizationPolicy.signedLift: only at explicitly declared scalar/range-ledger boundary
normalizationPolicy.normalizationBoundary: only declared reduction and encode boundaries

scalarLowering.constants: explicit formula constants and canonical fixed inverse scalars only
scalarLowering.unknownScalars: must be explicit and bound before execution

sourceListingFormat.serialization: exact source bytes; no pretty-print normalization

bchScriptProvenance.rationale: OP_1 through OP_16 cover dedicated small-integer constants; K=16 is design rationale only, not a measured-cost or lower-bound claim
bchScriptProvenance.provenanceNote: opcode values are source-pinned facts; any lookup-table fallback is non-authoritative

metricPolicy: all metrics remain null until an execution epoch binds source-bytecode-corpus-toolchain-run
